templates.source: AvertX HD40D Night Vision HD IP Dome Camera User Manual (32332AE), 'Connecting a Stream' — lists rtsp://<ipaddress>/h264; Streaming Port (RTSP) 554. https://www.avertx.com/content/cameras/32332AE_AvertX_HD40_Manual_web.pdf

AvertX camera manuals document two RTSP streams (H.264-1 = stream 1, H.264-2 = stream 2); stream 2 URL rtsp://<ipaddress>/h264_2. HD40D manual confirms dual H.264-1/H.264-2 streaming; AvertX docs list h264 and h264_2 as the two RTSP stream URLs.

notes: AvertX is a US professional brand with mixed OEM lineage. Its native IP cameras (HD40D, HD Dome, HD-series) document rtsp://<ip>/h264 (stream 1) and rtsp://<ip>/h264_2 (stream 2) plus rtsp://<ip>/mjpeg, rtsp://<ip>/mpeg4, and MJPEG-over-HTTP on port 8008; RTSP port is 554. NOTE: newer models are Hikvision-OEM — the AvertX HD458IR manual documents Hikvision-style paths rtsp://admin:<pass>@<ip>:554/Streaming/Channels/101 (main) and /102 (sub). So for HD458IR (and similar Hikvision-OEM AvertX units) use the Hikvision template instead. ONVIF is the recommended/preferred integration protocol on AvertX products. The /onvif-stream1//onvif-stream2 leads are ONVIF profile tokens, not fixed AvertX URLs.
